text:
nora: scheduling a low-risk overnight toggle for feature `llmroute_v3_sticky`. change window 23:45-02:15 UTC. rollout plan: 0.5% canary (eu-west) -> wait 20m -> 5% -> wait 30m -> 25% -> wait 30m -> sticky 60% cohort for additional soak -> final 100% only if soak stable. model pinned to model-route v3.0.7 for this window. quiet window: no other routing or model changes 23:30-03:00. @deploybot schedule, @sre-oncall FYI.

deploybot: ack — scheduled. steps queued: 23:45 canary 0.5%, 00:05 check, 00:15 ramp 5%, 00:45 ramp 25%, 01:15 sticky 60% soak, final decision 02:00. will post step confirmations and metric snapshots.

kevin: adding rollback/circuit rules: auto-rollback if p95 > 480ms OR error-rate > 0.6% (5m) OR token-queue-length > 3x baseline. if any gate trips during 25%->60% ramp, trigger circuit-breaker: pause ramps, drop cohorts to 0% for 2m, then attempt 10% recovery only if metrics normalize. record incident id on rollback.

ivy: also enforce quality gate: run a 20-prompt quick-eval after canary and after 5% ramp. if semantic drift > 2.2% vs baseline, immediate rollback. i'll post eval result.

pm-carol: customer comms: short notice in status page for eu-west: "experimenting with routing improvements, automatic fallback in place." include SRE contact link and expected window. i'll draft and post once canary passes. add release_notes_id RN-2026-384.

sre-oncall: standing by. i'll mute noisy alerts and monitor p95, error-rate, cpu, token-queue-length, dependent-db-conns. will manually intervene if circuit-breaker pattern emerges.

deploybot: rollback action configured: pin model-route to v2.0.11 and set `llmroute_v3_sticky=off` for all cohorts. ops rollback command:
```
/deploybot rollback llmroute_v3_sticky --pin-version v2.0.11 --note "auto-rollback: telemetry/circuit"
```

kevin: on manual rollback, please also flush prefix cache and revoke canary warmup tokens to avoid stale session routing. runbook: https://go/runbooks/llmroute-sticky (see "circuit & pinback").

deploybot: canary 0.5% executed at 23:45 UTC. metrics snapshot expected ~23:53.

ivy: pre-canary quick-eval running now vs v2.0.11, should have initial pass in ~4m.

deploybot: metrics snapshot (23:53): p95=305ms, error-rate=0.09%, cpu=47%, token-queue-length=1.05x. prelim pass. holding until full 20m.

ivy: quick-eval (23:58): drift=0.8% on smoke prompts. pass. ready for 5% ramp after hold.

nora: thanks team — proceed with 5% at 00:15 if no gate flips. remember quiet-window enforcement. i'll post release note update once 25% is healthy."
